title: Specialist-ensemble arbiter and precision fallbacks for rerank endpoint
creator: Ana Rodriguez
description: Goal: Improve reranking quality across long-tail locales and high-latency-sensitive workloads by introducing an ensemble of small locale-specialist cross-encoders plus a compact universal fallback, and an arbiter service that selects the best model variant per-request under latency and cost SLOs. Motivation: single monolithic cross-encoders either waste compute on majority locales or underperform on minority languages. The specialist-ensemble approach aims to increase per-query relevance while keeping p50/p95 latency within current SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Arbiter routes >=95% of high-traffic locale requests to specialist models when specialist accuracy delta > 3% over fallback on eval sets. 2) End-to-end rerank p95 latency <= 220ms on baseline traffic mix. 3) No regression >1% absolute in English anchor metrics. 4) Canary run shows no increased error-rate or resource contention for 48h at 2x baseline traffic.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Unit tests + local eval harness. Phase 1: Internal canary (10% traffic) using control-group logging to compare scores. Phase 2: Gradual ramp to 50% with automatic rollback on metric regression. Phase 3: Global rollout with burst capacity configs. Arbiter feature flagged per-customer and per-route. Canary evaluation stored in S3 and dashboards in Grafana. Full rollout gated on regression test pass and SLO smoke checks.
test_plan: - Offline eval: multilingual held-out sets (20 locales, heavy tail). - Latency bench: p50/p95 with on-prem and hosted runtimes across sequence lengths 32/128/512. - Smoke regressions: seeded production prompts and human review sample of 500 pairs. - A/B: live traffic paired scoring to compute delta in NDCG@10 and click-through proxies. - Resource profile: GPU memory, CPU dispatcher latency, KV cache hit-rate. - Regression harness integration: run against rerank-regression-suite v2.3.
metrics: Primary: NDCG@10 delta (locale-specific), p95 latency (ms), cost-per-req (GPU-ms). Secondary: KV cache hit-rate, model load failures, queue depth. Canary thresholds: NDCG@10 drop >0.015 or p95 latency increase >30ms triggers rollback.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Arbiter misroutes and increases p95 latency under burst. Mitigation: conservative default: route to fallback when runtime queue > 20, circuit-breaker per-instance. Risk: specialist models overfit small locales. Mitigation: combine specialist score with fallback via calibrated linear blending and require minimum sample size for promotion. Risk: increased model count increases infra overhead. Mitigation: deploy specialists as quantized int8 variants and shared KV cache warmstart to reduce memory.
